name: Bronze Chimera Trialbeast
loreTies: A sacred trial creature assembled by Olympian arena law; it proves worth through mixed threats, not random monstrosity.
Combines melee, hazard, and debuff pressure.
source culture humans later copied as Greek myth
shortBackstory: Bronze Chimera Trialbeast is a lore-faithful Olympian run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Bronze Chimera Trialbeast belongs to The Celestial Heights of Olympus and exists to express Olympian law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Combines melee, hazard, and debuff pressure.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Bronze lion-goat-serpent form, marble joint rings, ember mane, laurel brand. Abilities — Tri-Aspect Maul, Arena Flame, Serpent Feint — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
